entities.name: Coracin
entities.description: Davvol's homeland, probably a nation whose people worshipped the Gift of the Gods and commonly had innate mental powers.

entities.name: Davvol
entities.description: Native of Coracin with a unique ability to read surface thoughts even among the Coracin.

entities.name: Gift of the Gods
entities.description: Ancient artifact of Thran or possibly Phyrexian origin, housed in the most sacred temple and worshipped by Coracin's inhabitants.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Possible origin of the Gift of the Gods.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Possible origin of the Gift of the Gods.

relations.quote: Coracin was the place Davvol came from.
